title: Page 45
transc:
Washington March 27 / 64
Geo D Sheldon ....
Florence for Knave can you spare pilgrim
Duvalls Company now in accomac to go
hum to acton to vote at the
elect shun on the plague of april
Youth Brutus how are you to day
44 pd  T. T. Eckert 


Ft Monroe Mar 28th 1864
Maj Eckert
for India unity I will
send home Duvalls pacific using
another Company for the time
being Yoke Knox Katy pleasant
Geo D Sheldon


Ft. Monroe March 28 1864
Geo W Baldwin Baltimore
for Tappan Shelby Wallace Banditti unity I
think you had better oakum at once
pandora William Chestnut Corner of south and
pratt streets baptism and hold him safe
zebra please send me by whelp nights
boat a confident shall member of your
staff of high intelligence Youth Knox Topsy
Geo D Sheldon
